text:
Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the modern workplace. One of its most significant impacts is automation, where AI handles repetitive tasks like data entry or scheduling. This frees up employees to focus on more creative and complex work. Beyond that, many companies now use AI-powered productivity tools that can analyze large amounts of information in seconds, helping teams make better decisions faster.

However, AI is not simply replacing people. Instead, the future lies in human-AI collaboration, where machines handle the heavy lifting and humans provide judgment and emotional intelligence. While some jobs will change or disappear, new roles are emerging, such as AI trainers or ethics managers. The key for workers is to embrace lifelong learning and adapt to this evolving partnership.
